Figure 1: Batch-level LLM routing framework assigns an LLM to each query within a batch by solving a constrained optimization problem that maximizes average per-query performance. The formulation enforces both a global monetary cost budget on total inference cost and individual capacity constraints for each LLM. Each query is assigned to exactly one LLM, so among 𝑥𝑖,1, . . . , 𝑥𝑖,𝑀 only one equals 1 and the rest are 0. Since the true performance of an LLM on a new query is unknown at decision time, it must be estimated via 𝑎𝑖, 𝑗 .
